additional_info.subject: ID0391530-DC/Si-D/FR[170000887] - Outlet 2 not charging CRM:00315002108
additional_info.body:
Hi Florian, good afternoon.
It seems that this problem is previous to this reported date of the ticket opening.
There has been a lot of errors of the IMD since earliest
2024-11-02T07:09:29.738Z
On this day 2/Nov/2024 there was still a successfull charging session on DC2 at:
2024-11-02T16:24:21.901Z
Afterwards there has occurred more than 1000 times the error with IMD-BC2 and no other successful sessions on DC2. When anyone tries to start a session we get the error message:
We need to check this on site and possibly replace it.
Should I ask for the regional colleagues support?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
